verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses by the Red Sea, in the tabernacle, on the first day of the second month of that year. It was the second year after they had left Egypt.
verses.2: Bring the heads of every tribe of the children of Israel back to their families, to their fathers’ houses, according to the number of their names. This will be a memorial for all those who have died.
verses.3: From the age of forty years onward, all the rulers in Israel will be under your command. You and Ahron will rule over them as rulers.
verses.4: And among you, each person will be a leader for his own family. Each person will be the head of his own household.
verses.5: And these are the names of the men who will stand with you to serve Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.6: To Shimon Shlumi’el, son of Zurishadai.
verses.7: To Judah, Nahshon son of Aminadab.
verses.8: To Isachar, Nataniel, son of Zuar.
verses.10: Livney Yosef for Ephraim Elishama, son of Judah; for Menashe Gamliel, son of Pdatsur.
verses.11: Let Laban and his son Gidion be taken away.
verses.12: To Dan Ahijzer, son of Amishadai.
verses.13: So that Paggiel son of Achran would be destroyed.
verses.15: To Naphthali Ahir’ah, son of Eynan.
verses.16: These are the rulers of the tribes; they are the leaders of their fathers. They are the heads of thousands of Israelites.
verses.17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who were buried in their graves.
verses.18: And all these descendants gathered together during the second month. They became children of their parents, according to the number of their names, starting from the age of forty years and up.
verses.19: When Jehovah commanded Moses, they were stationed in the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.20: And the sons of Reuben were born in Israel. They were born into their families, within their ancestral homes. Their names were recorded by their ancestors. Every man who was born after the age of forty was counted as part of this group.
verses.21: Their number was six hundred and forty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.22: The children of Shem will be born to their families, into the houses of their ancestors. Their names will be recorded in the list of their descendants. Every male child who is born after the age of forty will be counted among them.
verses.23: Their number is nine hundred and fifty thousand, with three thousand more.
verses.24: The children of their offspring will be born into their families, in the house of their ancestors. All of them will come forth from their parents, after a period of seventy years.
verses.25: Their number is five hundred and forty thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.26: The children of Judah will be born into their families, in the house of their ancestors. This happens after they have lived for forty years. All of them will come forth as one.
verses.27: Their number was four hundred and seventy thousand six thousand.
verses.28: The children of Israel shall be born into their families, in the homes of their ancestors. This will happen after a period of forty years. All of them will come forth from their mothers.
verses.29: Their numbers were four hundred and fifty thousand and four hundred.
verses.30: The children of Zebulun shall be born into their families, in the house of their ancestors. This will happen after forty years have passed since their birth. All those who are born during that time will be counted as part of this group.
verses.31: Their number was seventy-five thousand four hundred.
verses.32: The children of Joseph, and the children of Ephraim, shall bear children for their families. They will be descendants of their ancestors, in accordance with the number of their names. This applies to those who are born after the age of forty.
verses.33: Their number was four hundred and fifty thousand.
verses.34: The children of Manasseh shall be born into their families, in the house of their fathers. This will happen after they have lived for forty years, and all those who are born will be counted.
verses.35: Their numbers were two hundred and thirty thousand.
verses.36: The children of Benjamin will be born into their families, in the house of their ancestors. This happens after forty years have passed since their birth. All of them will come forth as one.
verses.37: Their numbers amounted to five thousand, three hundred and forty-four thousand.
verses.38: The children of Dan shall be born into their families, in the homes of their ancestors. This will happen after a period of forty years. All those who are born during this time will be counted as part of that generation.
verses.39: Their number was two hundred and sixty-seven thousand.
verses.40: The children of their children will be born into their families, in the homes of their ancestors. This will happen after a period of seventy years.
verses.41: Their number is one hundred and forty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.42: The sons of Naphtali shall be born into their families, in the house of their fathers. They will all come forth in the number of fifty years, and above that age.
verses.43: Their number is three hundred and fifty-four thousand.
verses.44: These were the leaders who were appointed by Moses and Aaron. There were twenty-two leaders in total; each of them was a leader for his own family.
verses.45: And all the officers of the Israelites were appointed to serve in their homes, since they were forty years old. And every leader among the Israelites also served in his own home.
verses.46: And all the prisoners numbered six thousand, three thousand, fifty, and fifty.
verses.47: And the Levites who were in their father’s houses did not settle down there.
verses.48: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.49: But do not touch the head of Levi, and do not carry his head among the children of Israel.
verses.50: And you shall command the Levites to take care of the tabernacle and all its utensils. They shall also take care of everything that belongs to it. They will serve it, and they will camp around the tabernacle.
verses.51: And during the journey to the tent, they would bring along the Levites. In the tents of the tent, they would establish their own tribes and clans. The stranger who came from afar would also die.
verses.52: And the Israelites stood by their camps, with one man over each camp, and one man over each flag.
verses.53: And the Levites shall dwell around the tabernacle of the priest. There will be no wrath upon the priests of Israel. The Levites shall keep the tabernacle of the priest in good condition.
verses.54: And the children of Israel did all that Jehovah commanded Moses. They did just as He said.
